brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's corruption trial faces potential unraveling, with prosecutors and judges reportedly at odds over how to proceed, according to Al Jazeera English. The trial, which centers on Netanyahu's most serious charges, has encountered procedural obstacles that could affect its trajectory.

The developments suggest mounting complications in the legal case against the Israeli leader. Netanyahu has denied all allegations in the trial, which began in 2020 and addresses charges including bribery, fraud, and breach of trust.
dek: Could Netanyahu escape his most serious corruption charges? Al Jazeera's Lina-Serene explains.
title: Netanyahu corruption trial shows signs of collapse, Al Jazeera reports
